about me

Practical, reliable,
and quick to learn.

I'm an IT student at ICST University Park, currently completing my Higher Diploma in Information Technology. I enjoy work where accuracy matters: building dashboards, analysing spreadsheets, designing databases and writing Python to save time on repetitive tasks.

Alongside my studies I volunteer as an instructor, teaching DBMS and Python and running basic computer skills training in local communities. My background also includes a Biology-stream A/L and healthcare training — Emergency Medical Technician, home caregiver and first aid — so I'm comfortable in responsible, people-facing roles where calm thinking counts. I'm looking for a role where I can contribute from day one and keep growing.
